name: Trans-Alaska Pipeline System (TAPS) drag-reducer programme
description: first commercial use of a polymeric drag-reducing additive to raise crude-oil pipeline flow, beginning 1979 after two full-scale experiments (Burger et al., 1982); DRA let TAPS exceed its design throughput

sources.note: Burger et al., Flow Increase in the Trans Alaska Pipeline Through Use of a Drag Reducing Additive (1982, cited 281x); semanticscholar record (first commercial use 1979); read 2026-10-28
